t: Secret Instruction Issued By The Railway Authorities Against Subversive Activities At The North Station

pages.en:
FM. 2.
G. 40M-9-35
SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.I, Special Branch / 9000878 36
REPORT
Date August 18, 1936
Subject Secret instruction issued by the Railway Authorities against
subversive activities at the North Station.
Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [Signature]

On August 17 the management of the N.S.R. and S.H.N.R.
issued a confidential order to its employees stating that
"spies" of a certain clique had been active at the North
Station recently for the purpose of reporting on the movements
of Chinese notables and military activities. In conclusion
the order instructed all employees not to associate with suspicious
characters or to give information to strangers, under the
penalty of dismissal followed by legal action.
In addition, the North Station Branch of the Public Safety
has, with effect from August 17, increased its plain clothes
staff at the North Station from 3 to 17. The Woosung-Shanghai
Defence Commissioner's Headquarters has detailed eight detectives
and 10 scouts for duty in the vicinity of the North Railway
Station.

Sih Tse liang
D. I.

DBR
18/8

D.C. (Crime & Special Branches)

Increase of staff at North Stn from PSB and Defence Commr's office
confirmed from enquiries. Measures adopted said to
be due to rumours and as a precaution
against trouble amongst Japanese Travellers.
Jani 18/8.

（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF POLICE SHANGHAI 19 AUG. 1936）
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (CRIME BRANCH) 18 AUG. 1936）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
S.I, 特别处 / 9000878 36
报告
日期：1936年8月18日
主题：铁路当局针对北站颠覆活动发布的秘密指令。
撰写人：侦探督察 施子良（Sih Tse-liang） 转呈人：[签名]

8月17日，沪宁铁路（N.S.R.）与淞沪铁路（S.H.N.R.）管理局向其员工发布了一项密令，指出某派系的“间谍”最近在北站活动，旨在报告中国要员的动向及军事活动。该命令最后指示所有员工不得与可疑人物交往或向陌生人提供信息，违者将被解雇并追究法律责任。

此外，自8月17日起，公安局北站分局已将驻北站的便衣人员从3名增加至17名。吴淞上海防卫委员会总部已派遣8名侦探和10名侦察员在北火车站附近执行任务。

施子良（Sih Tse liang）
侦探督察

DBR
8月18日

副警务处长（刑事处与特别处）

经查询证实，公安局与防卫委员会办公室已增加北站人手。据悉，采取这些措施是由于谣言以及作为预防日本旅客发生骚乱的 precautionary measures（预防措施）。
Jani 8月18日.

（印：上海警务处处长办公室 1936年8月19日）
（印：副警务处长（刑事处） 1936年8月18日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7502
S.1, Special Branch 14-9-36
REPORT
Date September 14, 1936.
Subject Chinese Police and Military Authorities establish joint
office at North Railway Station - Japanese enquiries
Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by M. [签名]

It is reported that at 9.30 a.m. September 13, four
Japanese in foreign clothes were at the North Station and
vicinity enquiring among the porters regarding the location
of the joint office established by the Chinese military and
police authorities (Vide I.R. 11/9/36). Failing to obtain
the necessary information, they left at about 10.30 a.m.
At 4.30 p.m. three other Japanese also in foreign
clothes came to the North Station and made similar enquiries.
They left at 5.30 p.m. without obtaining the information.
In consequence of these activities, the Chinese
Authorities are conducting investigations into the matter,
with a view to ascertaining from what source the Japanese
obtained the information. It is learned that preparations
are being made to change the name and address of the Joint
Office.

Sih Tse liang
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：Copy sent 14-9-36 / for）

档案号 7502
S.1, 特别处 14-9-36
报告
日期：1936年9月14日。
主题：中国警察与军事当局在北火车站设立联合办公室 - 日本人的查询
撰写人：侦探督察 施子良（Sih Tse-liang） 转呈人：M. [签名]

据报，9月13日上午9时30分，四名身着西装的日本人出现在北站及其周边地区，向搬运工查询由中国军警当局设立的联合办公室的位置（参见1936年9月11日情报报告）。由于未能获得必要信息，他们于上午10时30分左右离开。
下午4时30分，另外三名同样身着西装的日本人来到北站，进行了类似的查询。他们于下午5时30分离开，未获得相关信息。
鉴于这些活动，中国当局正在对此事进行调查，以查明日本人是从何处获得该信息的。据悉，当局正准备更改该联合办公室的名称和地址。

施子良（Sih Tse liang）
侦探督察
特别处主管。

（批：归档 / 供阅）
（批：副本已发送 14-9-36 / 供阅）

EXTRACT FROM INTELLIGENCE REPORT DATED 11/9/36
........

Chinese Police and Military Authorities establish
joint office at North Railway Station

A joint office to maintain order at the North
Railway Station was established on September 10 by
the Bureau of Public Safety, the Railway Police,
the N.S. & S.H.N. Railway Administration, and the
Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters.
The office is situated in the headquarters of the
Special Kuomintang for the Shanghai Nanking and
Shanghai Hangchow Ningpo Railways at the North Station
and is in charge of Hsu Hsueh-chi ( 乔学启 ),
Commander of the Second Regiment of the local Peace
Preservation Corps.
pages.zh:
摘自1936年9月11日的情报报告
........

中国警察与军事当局在北火车站设立联合办公室

为维护北火车站秩序，公安局、铁路警察、沪宁与淞沪铁路管理局以及吴淞上海卫戍司令部于9月10日联合设立了一个办公室。该办公室位于北站国民党京沪、沪杭甬铁路特别党部 headquarters（总部），由当地保安团第二团团长徐学启（Hsu Hsueh-chi，原文注：乔学启）负责。
